decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 8 August 2007, an erection of a single storey rear extension, a rear roof extension with two windows and the installation of two roof lights in the front roof plane has the volume of 48.7m3, as shown on drawing numbers 177-01, received 15th June 2007, was unlawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension, a rear roof extension with two windows and the installation of two roof lights in the front roof plane, the resulting building would fall outside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class (e) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension with roof windows to front of the house
